sections.title: Halloween 2026
sections.description: Verified item releases; exact closing time remains unknown.

entries.name: Haunted Hatchet
entries.description: Wood R Us · $16,661. Specialized for Spooky and Sinister wood. Added October 1, 2026.

entries.name: Carved Pumpkin
entries.description: Bob's Shack · $702. Unboxing gives a random size. Added October 1, 2026.

entries.name: Burnt Bag of Candy
entries.description: Fancy Furnishings · $1,009. Contains eight candy designs, including a rare unlabeled black bar; its drop chance is unverified.

entries.name: Ferry
entries.description: $400 per crossing. The departure cycle is 6 minutes from a departure at either dock; crossing time is 2 minutes 12 seconds. Start a timer from the Events & timers tab when you observe the departure.

entries.name: Bridge
entries.description: $100 lowers the bridge for 3 minutes. Additional toll payments stack. Super Bridge owners can lower it free.

entries.name: The Den
entries.description: The standard axe quest uses a Bag of Sand, Can of Worms and Lightbulb. On October 31, the reward changes from Rukiryaxe to End Times Axe.

entries.name: Christmas gifts
entries.description: Browse the past gift collections by year in the catalog. New 2026 gift dates and items have not been verified.

entries.name: Thanksgiving collectibles
entries.description: Past seasonal food and collectible items are included. The 2026 release schedule has not been verified.

events.title: Halloween 2026
events.notes: October 1 release: Haunted Hatchet at Wood R Us ($16,661), Carved Pumpkin at Bob's Shack ($702), Burnt Bag of Candy at Fancy Furnishings ($1,009). Exact closing hour is unconfirmed.

events.title: End Times · October 31
events.notes: The wiki lists an annual October 31 event. The Den awards the End Times Axe instead of Rukiryaxe. Exact server activation/closing hours are unconfirmed.

timerPresets.title: Ferry departure cycle
timerPresets.notes: Start at an observed departure from either dock. Passengers without tickets can delay departure. This is a server-relative reminder.

timerPresets.title: Ferry crossing
timerPresets.notes: Start when the ferry leaves. The wiki gives a 2 minute 12 second crossing; lag may affect the trip.

timerPresets.title: Bridge lowered
timerPresets.notes: Start when paying the $100 toll. Each additional payment adds 3 minutes; restart or adjust your timer to match.

contentNote: Public catalog with account-specific owned checks. Original prices are in-game money, not trading prices. Removed items remain historical references.
